cases.source:
warrant corpus
  assume platform:
    none
  assume environment:
    none
  error E = Length
  op select(a: Bytes, b: Bytes, choice: Bool) -> Result<Bytes, E> fresh
  labels select:
    a.contents secret
    a.length public
    choice secret
  input select.a:
    hostile
    rejects len(a) != len(b) with E.Length
    ensures no_panic, terminates
  bound select:
    steps <= 64 * len(a) + 512
    heap <= 2 * len(a)
    depth <= 32
witnesses: rejection=rejects len ( a ) != len ( b ) with E.Length
